home.headline: Big questions.
home.description: Volunteer-led math and science learning, shaped around each grade. Explore our curriculum, find individual support, or help a student take their next step.
home.curriculumIntro: Math, biology, chemistry, physics, and earth science—introduced at the right level, with room to ask questions and understand the ideas. Choose a grade band to explore a sample lesson.
home.aboutText: We’re a nonprofit with a simple belief: a new perspective can open a whole new world. BTS connects volunteers with schools to bring curriculum-based learning to students at different grade levels.
home.tutoringIntro: Sometimes a little individual attention can make a big difference. Our 1-on-1 tutoring focuses on the math and science topics you want to understand better, with room to ask questions, revisit tricky ideas, and work through problems.
home.contactIntro: Questions about a lesson, a school visit, or getting involved? Start a conversation with Breaking the Sky.
